name: AsiaQuest Co.,Ltd.
summary: AsiaQuest Co., Ltd. enables digital transformation for businesses in Japan and global markets. It provides DX consulting and tailored solutions, develops and integrates IoT and AI systems, and supports cloud integration on platforms such as Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure. It also builds web systems and mobile applications and works on UI and UX design. Dating from 2012, it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
